generation.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer / pose-preserving reskin.
Asset type: four-frame Fire X3 sprite animation, exact original choreography.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET and ABSOLUTE POSE AUTHORITY: four original faceless sword-and-shield animation frames arranged 2 columns x 2 rows. Input image 2 supplies ONLY Laema's appearance/material style, NOT a pose or sword angle.
Primary request: replace the original mannequin with Laema while preserving each original pose, visible joint positions, torso rotation, shield orientation and SWORD PATH. Do not invent a new attack. Do not turn these into four generic sword-ready poses.
Output one transparent 1024x1024 sheet, EXACT FOUR CELLS in 2x2 grid. Row-major order. No labels, numbers, borders, scenery, floor or shadows. Each figure stays in its original cell with full weapon and body in clear margins.
Laema appearance: adult woman, silver-white ponytail tied red, cream rolled sleeves, short blue vest, red waist sash, dark brown trousers, brown boots/gloves. Same modeled-volume low-resolution rendered sprite style as image2; no anime/chibi/vector style. Plain straight STEEL sword with simple steel crossguard, no golden/ornate hilt, no magic blade. One small round NAVY shield, silver rim and steel boss.
POSE LOCK:
1 TOP LEFT: head faces opponent to RIGHT, chest mostly toward viewer, shield on forward/right side of torso. Sword arm reaches BACK to LEFT at lower-chest level, elbow bent slightly down-left; blade points almost horizontally LEFT and just slightly up. Do NOT point sword forward/right or above head.
2 TOP RIGHT: preserve almost same torso/leg stance, draw sword backward-left a little higher: hand still left of torso around lower-chest level, blade points LEFT and slightly UP (about 20 degrees). Shield still forward/right of torso. This is a low windup, NOT an overhead windup.
3 BOTTOM LEFT: turn torso toward RIGHT so near sword shoulder and arm extend down/forward-right at waist/hip height. Bent elbow then forearm reaches forward-right; sword blade almost horizontal RIGHT with a very slight downward slope, low at waist/hip level. Shield now appears on BEHIND/LEFT side of torso because the torso rotated, exactly as source. Add ONLY source's small white slash arcs beyond blade's forward tip in THIS cell; no orange glow or magic explosion.
4 BOTTOM RIGHT: follow through low to RIGHT, same rotated body and shield behind/left, sword hand slightly farther right/lower; blade points right with shallow downward slope. No white arc remains. Do NOT return to front-facing idle.
Never change sword/shield hands; match handedness/occlusion seen in original rather than mirroring. Fixed source stance/hips and leg spread; no extra step, jump, overhead swing, thrust or flourish. The original sprites crop some lower legs and tips: retain visible limb directions, complete only the missing boots/tip conservatively in padding; do not pretend new motion. Preserve original sword lengths relative to body consistently. Same scale/lighting and foot baseline across all cells. Background must be genuinely alpha-transparent.

repair.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Image1 is the four-frame Laema X3 sheet to refine; image2 is the absolute original pose reference. Keep the exact transparent 2x2 grid, all four figure sizes/locations, Laema face/outfit/hair, plain steel sword, navy shield, lower two poses and all blade directions UNCHANGED. Correct ONLY the sword-arm elbow in the TOP TWO cells: original has a distinctly bent down-left elbow, not a straight outstretched arm. Keep sword hand at approximately the same low-chest height to the left of torso and blade pointing left (top-left almost horizontal, top-right slightly upward). Bend upper arm down-left so elbow sits BELOW the wrist, then forearm rises slightly from elbow to wrist. Do not raise sword overhead or aim it right; do not move sword hand far outward. Preserve original choreography, shield, torso, feet, clothes and the bottom two frames unchanged. No added text or background. Actual transparency.
